defect.mechanism: metal_cn was read from per_atom_nbr_zsets with metal_idx_in_kept (kept-atom frame) while the dict is keyed by the raw tmQM index, so the degree of an arbitrary atom was classified as the metal's coordination number.

consumer: NONE — AtomCloud.coord_geom_class is written and never read; _to_device_cloud does not carry it.
impact: No trained number changes today.  The fix matters because the field is documented as a MOD5 conditioning slot: wiring it up against the pre-fix values would feed the model a carbon's degree under the name 'metal coordination geometry'.
honest_limits: metal_cn counts every neighbour listed in the Wiberg BO block (up to 12), not the thresholded bond list, so it can exceed the bond graph's metal degree.
The class is None whenever (Z, CN) is unmapped; tmQM genuinely has 7- and 8-coordinate complexes, so None is not an error.
